records.issue_text: Reader thread's catch block only catches Exception, so Errors or exceptions thrown in the lambda itself are not recorded in caughtExceptions
records.rationale: In the new test `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the reader thread wraps the call to `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` in `try { ... } catch (Exception e) { caughtExceptions.add(e); }`. This will not record `Error` subclasses (e.g., `AssertionError`, linkage errors, OOME), so the test could miss failures happening in that thread and still pass because only `caughtExceptions` is asserted (`assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())`).
